hooks.command:
FILE=$(node -e "try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).tool_input?.file_path??'')}catch{}")
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi
OUTPUT=$(node packages/cli/dist/index.js check --files "$FILE" --format json 2>&1)
if echo "$OUTPUT" | node -e "process.exit(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).violations?.length?0:1)" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "$OUTPUT" >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
